items.verbatim: PPM: FUNCTIONAL ASYMMETRIES OF TRANS-HISTONE AND HISTONE-DNA CROSSTALK IN DEVELOPMENT -UNDERSTANDING HOW CELLS CONTROL GENE EXPRESSION IS A CENTRAL CHALLENGE IN BIOLOGY. GENES ARE PACKAGED IN CHROMATIN AND THEIR EXPRESSION IS CONTROLLED BY CHEMICAL MODIFICATIONS ON HISTONE PROTEINS AND DNA IN NUCLEO
